set.body:
## Objective

Measure cold/warm rigid and affine pair workloads, allocation, peak memory and all evaluation counters. Demonstrate no nonlinear setup/state/dispatch and no per-sample/patch allocation in qualified loops. Compare affected shared primitives to exact baseline.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 1.1, 13, FA-11L. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `benchmarks/flashalign JVM JMH`
- `linear cost receipts`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Publish median/p95 latency and complete costs against the <1 s rigid EPI and <2 s affine desirable targets without hiding preparation or failures.
2. AC-050 same-environment transform/resample regression <=10% or separately resolved exception; hot-path counters prove actual work.
3. Parallel/SIMD enablement requires scalar parity and measured benefit; fixed work blocks/reduction tree are tested.

## Blocking prerequisites

- L19: FA-L19: Build the independent pair benchmark runner and raw evidence schema
- L20: FA-L20: Calibrate and freeze linear modality presets on training data
- L21: FA-L21: Qualify the complete linear API across JVM and Scala.js

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-L22: Qualify linear phase costs and protect the fast path
